$comment: Official Morphir CLI delivery from finos/morphir. The CLI source is finos/morphir-dotnet, pinned as the ecosystem/morphir-dotnet submodule; its build (build/Build.ReleaseProfiles.cs) produces every artifact. This file holds what finos/morphir expects of that build independently of it: the offerings and platforms it must deliver, the runner that builds and qualifies each platform, the tag a release carries and the qualification results that are not yet accepted. tools/cli-release.ts reads it; tools/cli-release.test.ts checks it against the pinned source and the release workflow.

morphirup.$comment: The toolchain manager and the setup toolchain, built by the pinned source's own .github/workflows/morphirup-build.yml and attached under the names a finos/morphir-dotnet release of the same version gives them. platforms are build/Helpers/MorphirupRelease.cs Platforms; toolchainPlatforms are build/Helpers/ReleaseAssets.cs WindowsToolchainPlatforms. On a toolchain platform the self-contained offering is the toolchain job's host archive, the bytes its candidate, bundle and SHA256SUMS name, so cli-offering.yml does not build it there. setupJourney is the source's acquired setup test group, which morphirup-build.yml runs on each toolchain platform's own runner.

legacyAliases.decision: Maintainer decision of 9 November 2026 (finos/morphir#1146, REL-1 of the morphir-dotnet adoption): future legacy morphir-<rid>[.exe] and morphir-<rid>-v<version>.tar.gz names carry the same Native AOT bytes as the native-aot offering. Published assets stay as they are; the trimmed managed single-file build is retired. The aliases are names, not a fifth offering.
